directoryStems.mcq-765f7737231c2578f2a85a38: בת 70 אובחנה לאחרונה עם כולנגיוקרצינומה, אושפזה לאיזון תסמינים משניים למחלתה המתקדמת ולטיפול הכימי. תלונתה העיקרית היא בחילה אשר לא הגיבה ל- Ondansetron (Zofran) ול- Metoclopramide (Pramin). באנמנזה, מעבירה גזים, שוללת עצירות או שלשולים. כאב מאוזן תחת Targin. מה מהטיפולים הבאים מתאים?

highlightAliases.old: New Mexico study of 800 patients 65+: only 29% were asymptomatic at diagnosis; 48% presented within 2 months of symptom onset, but 19% delayed ≥12 weeks and 7.4% delayed ≥1 year (p1385).
highlightAliases.new: New Mexico study of 800 patients older than 65: only 29% were asymptomatic at diagnosis; 48% presented within 2 months of symptom onset, but 19% delayed ≥12 weeks and 7.4% delayed ≥1 year (p1385).

highlightAliases.old: By 2030, 70% of cancer patients will be 65+, with incidence in this group rising ~70% from 2010–2030. 16 million cancer survivors currently in the US, ~60% age 65+; by 2040, projected 26 million survivors, 73% age 65+, almost 50% age 75+ (p1392–1393).
highlightAliases.new: By 2030, 70% of cancer patients will be 65+, with incidence in this group rising ~70% from 2010–2030. The chapter counted 16 million US cancer survivors at the time of writing, ~60% age 65+; by 2040, projected 26 million survivors, 73% age 65+, almost 50% age 75+ (p1392–1393).

highlightAliases.old: CGA-guided intervention RCTs reduce treatment toxicity: cluster RCT across 41 practices, 718 patients → 20% absolute reduction in toxicity vs usual care; single-center MDT-CGA RCT in 620 patients → 10% reduction in chemo toxicity (p1388).
highlightAliases.new: Geriatric assessment reduced severe toxicity in two trials: in GAP70+ it fell from 71% to 51% with tailored recommendations for the oncologist, and in GAIN it fell from 60.6% to 50.5% with multidisciplinary implementation (p1388).

highlightAliases.old: Telomere shortening begins at age 30 and proceeds at ~1%/year loss; loss of telomere function → genetic instability → oncogenic mutation risk (p1383).
highlightAliases.new: Telomeres protect chromosome ends. Their progressive loss can destabilize chromosomes and increase mutation risk. Page 1383 describes a functional decline from age 30 at about 1% per year. Measured leukocyte telomere shortening also occurs in infancy, and its rate varies with age. Human leukocyte study

highlightAliases.old: ECOG performance status (0 = perfect health, 5 = death) alone is not sufficient in geriatric oncology — a comprehensive geriatric assessment (CGA) adds substantial prognostic/functional information even in patients with a good ECOG PS (p1387–1388).
highlightAliases.new: ECOG performance status (0 = fully active without restriction from disease, 5 = death) alone is not sufficient in geriatric oncology — a comprehensive geriatric assessment (CGA) adds substantial prognostic/functional information even in patients with a good ECOG PS (p1387–1388).

highlightAliases.old: Surgery: healing is compromised at every phase (↓inflammatory/proliferative response, altered collagen); geriatric comanagement improves 90-day postoperative mortality (p1388–1389).
highlightAliases.new: Surgery: healing is compromised at every phase (↓inflammatory/proliferative response, altered collagen); in a retrospective cohort of patients aged 75 or older undergoing cancer surgery, geriatric comanagement was associated with lower 90-day mortality (pp1388–1389). Original surgical cohort

highlightAliases.old: Immunotherapy (ICIs): equivalent incidence of high-grade irAEs in older vs younger adults, but worse overall survival among older adults who develop high-grade irAEs — likely because steroids/hospitalization for irAE treatment are less well tolerated (p1391).
highlightAliases.new: Immunotherapy (ICIs): one retrospective cohort observed similar frequencies of high-grade immune-related events by age. Among those with high-grade events, the older group had shorter median survival. Susceptibility to complications of steroids or hospitalization is one proposed explanation (p1391). Original cohort, Table 3

highlightAliases.old: Routine symptom assessment/intervention can improve overall survival upwards of 5 months with no change in cancer-directed treatment (p1391).
highlightAliases.new: In one trial of electronic symptom monitoring during treatment, median survival was 31.2 versus 26.0 months. A later community trial found better symptom control, function and quality of life without a survival difference. Symptom monitoring can help even when survival is unchanged (p1391). Original trial · PRO-TECT

highlightAliases.old: End-of-life nutrition: IV fluids/TPN/tube feeding do not prolong life and may worsen comfort (pulmonary congestion, edema); dehydration near death is generally comfortable except for xerostomia (treat with swabs/ice chips) (p1392).
highlightAliases.new: In the last days of life with advanced cancer, routine artificial hydration or nutrition has no established survival benefit and can add edema, pulmonary congestion or procedural burden. Ask about thirst and discomfort, offer mouth care and safe sips or ice chips as tolerated, and individualize decisions with the patient and family (p1392). NCI, Last Days of Life

highlightAliases.old: At what age does telomere shortening begin, and at what rate does it progress?
highlightAliases.new: How can loss of telomere function promote malignancy, and when has telomere shortening been measured?

highlightAliases.old: Begins at age 30, progressing at a loss of approximately 1% per year (p1383).
highlightAliases.new: Loss of chromosome-end protection can promote genomic instability. The chapter describes functional decline from age 30 at about 1% per year (p1383). Leukocyte measurements show that shortening is already present in early childhood and proceeds at an age-dependent rate.

highlightAliases.old: Surgery: healing can be compromised at every phase, including inflammatory and proliferative responses and collagen remodeling. The chapter reports that geriatric comanagement can improve 90-day postoperative mortality (pp1388–1389).Current practice (not the book): The cited retrospective cohort of cancer surgery patients aged ≥75 found an association with lower 90-day mortality. Original surgical cohort.

highlightAliases.old: 63% of home care for older cancer patients comes from informal caregivers; nearly 40% of these caregivers have their own comorbidities and rate their own health fair/poor (p1393).
highlightAliases.new: In the United States, 63% of home care for older cancer patients comes from informal caregivers; nearly 40% of these caregivers have their own comorbidities and are likely to rate their own health fair/poor (p1393).

highlightAliases.old: Targeted therapy: mostly oral, CYP450-metabolized — high drug-interaction risk with polypharmacy; higher rate of dose reduction/discontinuation in older vs younger patients (p1390).
highlightAliases.new: Targeted therapy: many agents are oral and can interact with CYP450 inhibitors or inducers — high drug-interaction risk with polypharmacy; higher rate of dose reduction/discontinuation in older vs younger patients (p1390).
